summary: Nine base records satisfied the business rules (R2732 and its duplicate R5958, R7377, R7850, R9286, R9636, R1188, R2670); after deduplicating entity CYPRESS-REN-54094 there are seven unique qualifying leases, and the five nearest were shortlisted: R2732 (0.80 mi, $11.28/sf/yr effective net), R7377 (1.03 mi, $16.93), R7850 (1.26 mi, $19.41), R9286 (1.49 mi, $9.47) and R9636 (1.72 mi, $22.12). R1188 (1.95 mi, $23.69) and R2670 (2.18 mi, $12.77) qualified but fell outside the five slots. Controlling updates: U-R7377-1 (executed amendment, effective 2026-08-20) applied to R7377; U-R9286-3 rejected as an unsigned draft; U-R7850-2 rejected as published after the 2026-08-31 cutoff. Effective net rents follow the client's undiscounted rent-only convention (annualized face quote, 2.5% steps at months 13/25/37/49, no face rent during free months, gross expenses deducted every month, TI subtracted once) and are not a market appraisal. No spreadsheet or CSV artifact was produced: file creation is outside this direct API control.
limitations: No workbook/CSV was generated; artifact delivery is outside this direct API control channel, so only the JSON analysis is provided.

Effective net rents are undiscounted and rent-only per the stated client convention; they exclude time value, commissions, downtime, escalation of operating expenses and any percentage/other rent, so they are not appraisal-grade.
Distances are taken as provided (distance_miles) and were not independently verified; no addresses or coordinates were supplied.

Records with null term, TI, free months or gross expense loads (R5936, R5587, R7843, R1369) were excluded as unknown rather than zero, which may understate the available comp set if those fields are in fact zero.
R2670 free-rent timing is assumed to occur in the first months of the term (months 1-2 of year 1) as the convention specifies; the extracts do not state whether free rent is upfront or spread.
R5958 vs R2732 duplication was resolved on identical entity_id and identical fields; if these are truly distinct suites at the same asset, one comp may be omitted.
U-R7850-2 (rent_quote 2, unit unstated) and U-R9286-3 were excluded on cutoff/unsigned grounds; if a signed, on-or-before-cutoff version exists, R7850's and R9286's economics would change materially.
Face-rent unit conversions from USD_per_sf_month to annual assume a 12x multiplier; no verification of stated units beyond the extracts was possible.
No sponsor/SPV parent mappings were present in the packet, so no SPV-to-parent consolidation was required or performed.
Tenant names, landlords, suite sizes beyond area_sf, and any contact information are not evidenced in the packet and are therefore not asserted.
